content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITIONS
content_blocks.text: ‘CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION’ means any proprietary information disclosed by one party to the other that is marked as confidential or that should reasonably be understood to be confidential.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_OBLIGATIONS
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party shall not disclose or use the Confidential Information except as necessary to perform its obligations under this Agreement.
